propositions: A push into a bare git repository spawns a detached background process (git maintenance run) that outlives the push command's return, leaving the object database being mutated while the next statement attempts to copy it with shutil.copytree.

The copytree fails not only on objects/maintenance.lock but on entire loose-object fanout directories (objects/2c, objects/2d, etc.) that are being pruned and repacked concurrently, making lock-file filtering insufficient to fix the race.

The fixture bare remote in test_copy_repoints_sibling_origin_and_keeps_refs_isolated is created with raw git init --bare at git defaults, allowing receive-pack to spawn detached auto-maintenance; pinning receive.autogc=false, gc.autoDetach=false, and maintenance.autoDetach=false before any push removes the concurrent mutator.

A new guard test (test_fixture_bare_remote_leaves_no_detached_upkeep_behind_a_push) runs the push under GIT_TRACE2_EVENT and asserts no git maintenance run child carries --detach, with a receive-pack positive control to prevent vacuous pass.
